_source_path.description: the vault path of the source document; the idempotency/dedupe key

certificate_number.description: the issuer's certificate or registration number

certifying_body.description: the body that issued the certificate (JAS-ANZ-accredited certifier, state road agency, council)

classifications.description: NPS category levels stated together on one certificate (road/bridge/financial/asphalt)

expiry_date.description: the date the certification lapses, `null`/absent when the document states none

holder.description: the certified legal entity name as stated on the document

issued_date.description: the date the certification was issued

jurisdiction.description: the jurisdiction the certificate is valid in

scheme.description: the scheme/standard label as stated, e.g. an ISO designation or a prequalification scheme name

scheme_key.description: the catalog scheme this certificate is evidence of holding

scope.description: the certified scope of work, as stated

summary.description: the one-line prose rendering of the fact

title.description: what the certificate or registration is
